summary: Backend-only iteration 3. 50/50 pytest cases pass against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (37 regression + 13 new). Verified: (1) /api/stats/me returns points, live_attended, breakdown{live,meditation,mantra}, rules — fresh user starts at 0. (2) Points math: 60-min meditation → breakdown.meditation=50; 120-min → 100; 108 chants → mantra=0 (round(108*50/11664)=0); 11664 chants → mantra=50. (3) /api/live/attend awards 100 first call (awarded_points=100), second call returns already_attended=true with no extra points; stats reflect live_attended=1, points=100; unknown session → 404. (4) /api/rank sorts leaderboard by points desc, every row has points+mins, self included in every scope (national/international/state/circle). (5) /api/mood/monthly-stats returns days=30, series length=30 with per-day counts{calm,happy,grateful,anxious,sad}; totals equal sum of series. (6) /api/diary auto-assigns today's date; ?date=YYYY-MM-DD filters correctly; /api/diary/dates returns [{date,count}]; /api/diary/{id} returns entry; unknown id → 404. (7) /api/books rewritten to 9 Brahmatheerth issues sorted by order asc, all price=500, author='HH Guruji Sundar', kind='magazine', external_url pointing to gurujisundar.com/product/. (8) /api/community/info returns name='Aathman Awareness Centre', founder, tagline, quote, guru_quote, about, hero_image, guru_image (customer-assets Guruji URL), website, shop, courses(4), articles(3), socials(7), testimonials(2). Regression suite (auth/OTP, profile, meditations, mantra, mood weekly, diary CRUD, live sessions list, books+orders MOCKED razorpay, guru messages/quote, QA, SOS, sleep, music, guruji-image migration) all still green. MOCKED integrations verified: Razorpay verify auto-succeeds, SendGrid replaced by dev_otp.

minor.issue: GURUJI_IMAGE constant is defined on line 901 — AFTER community_info() (line 812) references it. Works at runtime because the function body is evaluated on call and the module finishes loading before the first request, but it is fragile / a lint red flag. Move the constant to the top of the file with the other config constants.

Scope filters are best-effort: 'international' has no filter (returns same as 'national' when nationalities match), and 'state' silently skips users with no state set. Fresh users default nationality='India' but state=None → will always match national. Consider explicit semantics: international=other nationalities, state=same-state-only excluding NULL, circle=followed friends.
Iterates all users with activity + N+1 _compute_points (each does 3 aggregations). At scale this will be slow. Consider a single aggregation pipeline or cached points on the user doc.

Idempotent by (user_id, session_id) but there is no unique index on {user_id, session_id} in db.live_attend. A rapid double-tap could race and insert two docs (double points). Add a compound unique index.
(Carried) dev_otp is returned whenever SendGrid send fails, not strictly when OTP_DEV_MODE=true. Gate on OTP_DEV_MODE only for production safety.
(Carried) Uses Pydantic v1 body.dict(); migrate to body.model_dump(exclude_none=True) for Pydantic v2.
(Carried) bell_default migration in on_startup now exists but only writes fixed values regardless of existing DB — safe but silently overwrites any admin edits.

action_items: Move GURUJI_IMAGE constant to the top of server.py (currently defined after it is used in /api/community/info — works today but is a forward-reference smell).
Add unique compound index on db.live_attend {user_id: 1, session_id: 1} to hard-guarantee idempotency on race conditions.
Clarify /api/rank scope semantics: today international == national when both have nationality='India'; 'state' silently drops NULL-state users. Recommend explicit branching and documented rules.
Consider caching or single-pipeline computation for /api/rank — currently N+1 aggregations across all active users.
Optional: gate dev_otp response strictly on OTP_DEV_MODE=true; migrate body.dict() → body.model_dump() for Pydantic v2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1120 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (auth, points/stats, content, commerce, guru, community).
_compute_points is O(N * 3 aggregations) inside /api/rank — pull once via a single $facet aggregation, or denormalize points onto users doc updated on each write.
Forward-reference bug risk: GURUJI_IMAGE used at line 824 but defined at line 901. Only works because request-time evaluation runs after module load. Move it up.
No compound index on db.live_attend — idempotency relies on find_one race window.
community_info returns a large hard-coded dict inside the route handler; move to a module-level constant or JSON file for readability + easier updates.
